p: by the hand of Moses to: By Moses, by whose ministry God showed his power.
Kohathites: He means those that were priests: for some were but Levites.
thirteen cities: Every tribe gave more or fewer cities according to the size of their inheritance, Nu 35:8.
Aaron: For Aaron came from Kohath, and therefore the priests office remained in that family.
children of Aaron the priest Hebron: That is, the priest of the family of the Kohathites, of whom Aaron was chief.
suburbs: The suburbs were a thousand cubits from the wall of the cities round about, Nu 35:4.
the Levites which remained of the: That were not priests.
Shechem with her suburbs in mount: Hebron and Shechem were the two cities of refuge under the Kohathites.
half tribe of Manasseh: Who dwelt in Canaan.
Golan in Bashan with her suburbs: Golan and Kedesh were the cities of refuge under the Gershonites.
rest of the Levites: They are here called the rest, because they are last numbered, and Merari was the younger brother, Ge 46:11.
Bezer with her suburbs: Bezer and Ramoch were the cities of refuge under the Merarites and beyond Jordan, Jos 20:8.

within the possession of the children: Thus according to Jacob's prophecy they were scattered throughout the country, which God used so that his people might be instructed in the true religion by them.
